packMeta.name: FitStudio (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey personal training and gym coaching operations desk: live coach session board, client progress dossiers with automatic body-composition deltas, assessments log, workout program builder, trainer roster, and payments ledger. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 6 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
